# Allow-list for .github/scripts/native-hygiene.sh check 2 (docs/plans/step-9.md 9.16).
#
# Non-test, non-comment lines under apps/mobile-web/src/platform that mention localStorage or
# sessionStorage, one per line, written as
#
#   <repo-relative path>: <the source line, leading/trailing whitespace trimmed>
#
# A listed line must never store a token, refresh token or viewer JWT (those live only in the
# Keychain/Keystore secure store, docs/plans/step-9.md 2.5). Adding a line here needs a reviewer's
# OK.

# Launch-URL de-duplication (step 9): App.getLaunchUrl() is sticky for the process, so each
# launch URL is routed once per WebView session. Stores only a 32-bit FNV-1a digest of the URL
# under "ll.launch-url.v1", never the URL or its share/invite token.
apps/mobile-web/src/platform/native/NativeEvents.tsx: if (window.sessionStorage.getItem(LAUNCH_KEY) === d) return false;
apps/mobile-web/src/platform/native/NativeEvents.tsx: window.sessionStorage.setItem(LAUNCH_KEY, d);

# Album-sync presence marker (step 10, docs/plans/step-10.md 2.5): the constant "1" under
# "ll.sync.on" when album sync is set up on this phone, so launches skip loading the sync code and
# the Keychain for everyone else. No id, album title, token or URL; the sync config itself is in
# the Keychain ("ll.sync.v1"). Added in task 10.14; pending reviewer OK (header above).
apps/mobile-web/src/platform/native/syncFlag.ts: return window.localStorage.getItem(KEY) === "1";
apps/mobile-web/src/platform/native/syncFlag.ts: if (on) window.localStorage.setItem(KEY, "1");
apps/mobile-web/src/platform/native/syncFlag.ts: else window.localStorage.removeItem(KEY);

# Live-update check interval (step 14, docs/plans/step-14.md 2.3/2.8): `{ "lastCheckAt": <epoch ms> }`
# under APP_UPDATE_STATE_KEY ("ll.app-update.v1"), so launch/resume checks run at most every 6 h.
# No manifest, URL, signature, version id or token. Added in task 14.8; pending reviewer OK
# (header above).
apps/mobile-web/src/platform/native/appUpdate.ts: const raw = window.localStorage.getItem(APP_UPDATE_STATE_KEY);
apps/mobile-web/src/platform/native/appUpdate.ts: window.localStorage.setItem(APP_UPDATE_STATE_KEY, JSON.stringify({ lastCheckAt: at }));
